title: Summer 2027: Product Design Intern
location: Remote, US (includes 2-day in-person visit to Brooklyn, NY)
note: Paid remote K–12 edtech product design internship; must be returning to school in Fall 2027 and live in the US during the program.

facts.summary: Paid, remote 10-week product design internship at a K–12 education technology company, with a short in-person kickoff at its Brooklyn HQ.
facts.duties: Help with wireframes, prototypes (including simple HTML/CSS/JS), usability testing and final designs for web and mobile products; maintain design system components and style guides; work with product, engineering and research.
facts.requirements: Undergrad or grad student returning to school Fall 2027; full-time for the whole program; US work authorization and US residence; Figma or similar tools and a portfolio preferred; interest in edtech.
facts.apply: Apply online through Amplify's Ashby job posting.
